items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And Wynton Marsalis – I don’t – concert at Lincoln Center. I don’t remember that.

ctx.x: Yeah, that’s Rhythm-a-ning. Now this set, I don’t know anything about, this broadcast from Marciac with Stan Getz. And Sphere, the Northsea Jazz Festival. Oh, this I’ve never seen, J. J. Johnson and Stan Getz. It’s a broadcast from the Chicago festival. And Wynton Marsalis – I don’t – concert at Lincoln Center. I don’t remember that.
Good. That’s the kind of thing we want to do, is correct the historical record. But, maybe . . .
